place.source_title: Mackinaw Crossings shopping mall (1997), Mackinaw City

brief: A 1997 open-air shopping village: cream and red clapboard shop buildings with gables and cupolas round a paved red plaza, a gabled covered walkway with timber trusses, benches and lamps. Two photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: Mackinaw Crossings (Mackinaw City MI, 1997): an open-air themed shopping village of brightly painted 'Victorian' frame shop fronts with striped awnings around a brick-paved plaza with picnic tables and an old tree

why.note: the 1990s themed open-air centre: invented Victorian village fronts for tourists (festival / lifestyle)
